decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis has its own page and extends the firm's core market-data offer, so in a growing industry it plausibly meets aspirations and gives no cause for problemistic search.
The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core business and runs on the maintained databases at low marginal cost, so slack easily carries it.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent, has its own page and fits the platform strategy, so there is no shortfall that would justify dropping it.
The energy tariff calculator line has low web visibility and overlaps with C, so it could be consolidated, but its several models and low cost on shared data favour keeping it another year.
The site-specific tariff comparison line uses existing data close to the established offer, so despite modest visibility, slack and a growing market justify retaining it.
